Current official MCP rules exclude full-permission and rental Actors; current x402 rules require pay-per-event pricing, limited permissions, and no Standby. All five satisfy those published rules, and no separate whitelist is documented. No Actor call, wallet payment, prepaid token purchase, or paid test was started. That run failed closed on DEV HTTP 429 before any publication; the same-day guard prevents another fallback, and anonymous article ID 4399376 remains HTTP 404. Commit d4a62fd reduces five canonical checks to one paginated article-list scan, reuses that snapshot during publication, verifies once by article ID, and adds bounded Retry-After handling; all 78 tests passed. The Grants guide remains in order and cannot publish before 2026-08-16T03:19:24+08:00.
